name: Police Woman
description: Sergeant “Pepper"” Anderson, an undercover cop for the Criminal Conspiracy Unit of the Los Angeles Police Department, poses undercover from mob girl to prostitute.

videos.title: Pilot Police Story: The Gamble
videos.overview:
Pilot episode, called Police Story: The Gamble. Sergeant Lisa Beaumont (Angie Dickinson) works undercover to expose, & to bust illegal gambling houses.

The pilot for this show aired on an episode of "Police Story" (1973) entitled "The Gamble". However, Angie Dickinson's character's name in that episode was Lisa Beaumont and Bert Convy played the role of her commanding officer. Convy was later replaced by Earl Holliman.

videos.title: The End Game
videos.overview: Pepper and Crowley pose as bank employees to nail a particularly vicious gang of bank robbers.

videos.title: The Beautiful Die Young
videos.overview: Pepper and Crowley investigate a modeling school that takes advantage of young runaways girls, turning them into white slaves in Japan, or making them participate in pornographic movies.

videos.title: Warning: All Wives...
videos.overview: Pepper and Bill go undercover to catch a rapist/killer who is targeting the wives of patients at a hospital. The first suspect is the amorous parking attendant. However, Pepper is later abducted by the real killer, the nephew of a pair of nurses at the hospital, who kills as a way of getting back at his mother who abandoned him as a child.

videos.title: Seven Eleven
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover and impersonates an airline stewardess who is a link in a complex heroin smuggling chain.

videos.title: Anatomy of Two Rapes
videos.overview: In this episode two rapes are investigated.  The first victim is a woman who is raped the day before her daughter is supposed to get married.  The second victim is an alcoholic who was raped and murdered and her body dumped in a vacant lot.  It is later revealed that the first victim made up the story in order to stop the wedding. The second rape is solved when a teenager who was teased by the victim admits to killing her.

videos.title: It's Only a Game
videos.overview: Squad veterans question whether their newest member really wants the job or is being pushed into it by his father, a retired detective.

videos.title: Fish
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover in a woman's prison to gain the confidence of a fellow prisoner who has information that could put away a mobster.

videos.title: Flowers of Evil
videos.overview:
"Flowers of Evil" is a 1974 episode of the American police procedural television series Police Woman. The episode features Sgt. Suzanne "Pepper" Anderson going undercover at a nursing home to investigate a murder. She uncovers a trio of lesbians who are robbing and murdering their elderly residents. The episode, the 8th of the first season, originally aired on November 8, 1974.

Gay and lesbian organizations protested "Flowers of Evil", which producers said was based on a real case, for its portrayal of the killers as lesbians and for the stereotypical presentation of lesbianism. The episode aired a month after a similarly controversial episode of Marcus Welby, M.D. on ABC garnered national protests. Mindful of that recent controversy, NBC delayed the episode and ordered some changes but they were not enough to allay gay and lesbian concern over network television's negative portrayal of homosexuality. After negotiations, NBC agreed not to rerun the episode.

videos.title: The Stalking of Joey Marr
videos.overview: Pepper must transfer the son of a murdered gang chief from Mexico to testify against a killer.

videos.title: Requiem for Bored Wives
videos.overview: Bob Crane plays a freewheeling disc jockey who finds his wife murdered in her bed.

videos.title: Smack
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover as a high school teacher to hunt down a group of drug pushers.

videos.title: The Cradle Robbers
videos.overview: A search for a missing granddaughter of Sergeant Crowley's old friend leads Pepper to an adoption racket in which children are bought and sold.

videos.title: Shoefly
videos.overview: Internal Affairs gives Pepper and Crowley 72 hours to find the cop who switched barrels on a murder weapon before the accused killer got to court.

videos.title: Target Black
videos.overview: Pepper serves as bodyguard for a visiting campus speaker who, being black and Marxist, is a magnet for threats from hate groups.

videos.title: Sidewinder
videos.overview: Four Korean War vets armed with M-16s and a bazooka prepare to pull off Operation: Sidewinder, a heist of an armored car carrying a multi-million dollar payload. One of the men's penchant for prostitutes puts Pepper in the action undercover.

videos.title: Blast
videos.overview: The deaths of a prominent politician and a nightclub dancer in a car explosion send Pepper to work as a go-go dancer for the club's owner, a one-time poor boy with a powerful yen for the finer things in life.

videos.title: No Place to Hide
videos.overview: A clue is found linking a series of seemingly random murders: Each victim had testified against the mob and was now enjoying a new life in the Witness Protection Program. Pepper goes undercover as a secretary to uncover the leaker.

videos.title: Nothing Left to Lose
videos.overview: Larue Collins a police informer is pursued relentlessly by the mob. The song 'Me and Bobby McGee' is the theme used for this episode, which most describe as the best Police Woman episode.

videos.title: The Company
videos.overview: Three gangland killings signal that someone is taking over established vice activities. A gambling operator is feeling the heat, and Pepper is there to help.

videos.title: Ice
videos.overview: Posing as a couple of jewel fences, Pepper and Crowley travel to Masiaca, Mexico as part of a complex plan to nab a gang of diamond thieves.

videos.title: Bloody Nose
videos.overview: While working undercover as a waitress in a seedy roadside diner connected to a series of truckload heists, Pepper finds herself entangled in the ugly spousal abuse dispute between a young married couple in her apartment complex.

videos.title: The Loner
videos.overview: Pepper is strangely fascinated by a ruggedly individualistic ex-cop who works as a bodyguard and is antagonizing both the police and the gangster who's after his client.

videos.title: Pawns of Power
videos.overview: Pepper investigates an illegal gambling operation whose owners are also suspected of counterfeiting.

videos.title: The Score
videos.overview: A drug pusher's sale of particularly potent speed causes several overdose deaths, and creates an emotional crisis for the criminal's guilt-ridden girlfriend.

videos.title: Paradise Mall
videos.overview: A detective's wife is the latest of a killer's victims, who are all blondes and whose corpses are adorned with wedding veils.

videos.title: Pattern for Evil
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover as a fashion consultant when a designer loses more than just designs.

videos.title: The Chasers
videos.overview: A group of con artists who prey on car crash victims choose the wrong patsy — Pepper, who awakens in the hospital after being knocked unconscious by a speeding car.

videos.title: Cold Wind
videos.overview: Suspicion for the murder of two factory employees falls on two co-workers: a compulsive gambler who had a fight with one of the victims, and an enigmatic college student who disappeared on the night of the crime.

videos.title: Above and Beyond
videos.overview: After a parole officer is murdered, Pepper goes undercover as a parolee to find out why and how he was killed.

videos.title: Farewell, Mary Jane
videos.overview: Pepper engineers a major drug purchase to help capture a police informant turned drug dealer.

videos.title: Blaze of Glory
videos.overview: While posing as a prostitute, Pepper is taken hostage by a glory-seeking, bank-robbing couple.

videos.title: Glitter With A Bullet
videos.overview: While investigating the death of a well-known musician, Pepper becomes involved with a confused young rock star and his ruthless manager.

videos.title: The Purge
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover to clear Crowley, who is suspended for killing a teenager, and find out the real reason behind the attack.

videos.title: Don't Feed the Pigeons
videos.overview: When an old woman is killed for her possessions, Sgt. Pepper and the crew find that a group is using "the oldest trick in the book" to fool grannies out of their money.

videos.title: The Hit
videos.overview: A boxer's life hangs by a thread as a hitman, who had failed to get him the first time, must finish the job or his employers will finish him off.

videos.title: Silence
videos.overview: When a woman goes missing, her mute sister tries to find her, accusing the missing woman's husband of foul play.

videos.title: Incident Near a Black and White
videos.overview: Working under an ambitious Lieutenant with no street experience, Pepper and team go out in search of a cop killer.

videos.title: The Melting Point of Ice
videos.overview: A robbery goes wrong and the situation becomes more complicated when the stolen diamonds go missing. Suspicion centers on a construction site, and Pepper goes undercover as a caterer to try and discover who at the site has the diamonds.

videos.title: The Pawn Shop
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover to catch a burglar dealing in high grade antiques through a pawnshop.

videos.title: Angela
videos.overview: When the boyfriend of a drug dealer's daughter is framed, the team investigates.

videos.title: Wednesday's Child
videos.overview: A cat burglar and a nightclub singer are enlisted to break up a burglary ring that preys on wealthy single women.

videos.title: Generation of Evil
videos.overview: Pepper goes undercover in Las Vegas to find the kidnapped grandson of an elderly millionaire.

videos.title: Double Image
videos.overview: Royster falls in love with a key witness he is tasked to protect in a murder trial.

videos.title: Mother Love
videos.overview: A young woman who is mentally disturbed kidnaps the child she gave up at birth.

videos.title: Task Force: Cop Killer (1)
videos.overview: While training with a motorcycle task force to prove women can be   effective motorcycle cops, Pepper falls for a smooth talker.

videos.title: Task Force: Cop Killer (2)
videos.overview: While her new love hovers near death, Pepper sets out to discover who brutally ran him down.

videos.title: The Trick Book
videos.overview: An influential banker informs the police that he is being   blackmailed by Madame Hilary La Salle, operator of a very   classy brothel. Apparently she has been keeping a little   black book - her 'trick book' - containing details of all   her clients.

videos.title: Tender Soldier
videos.overview: Pepper poses as a revolutionary to nab the terrorist who murdered a police officer.

videos.title: Trial by Prejudice
videos.overview: Pepper, suspended from duty, faces a departmental trial when a suspect claims that Pepper sexually molested her at the time of her arrest.

videos.title: Sarah Who?
videos.overview: Crowley vows vengeance on the psychopath who killed the policewoman Crowley was dating.

videos.title: Broken Angels
videos.overview: The victim of a murder attempt arranged to look like a drunk-driving crash is an officer with a drinking problem.

videos.title: Brainwash
videos.overview: Pepper poses as an investigative news reporter to probe the private school where several teenagers have mysteriously died.

videos.title: The Lifeline Agency
videos.overview: Pepper and Crowley pose as a wealthy couple anxious to negotiate with a baby-selling operation.

videos.title: Tennis Bum
videos.overview: Pepper is working undercover on a syndicate case, and becomes romantically involved with a tennis pro; what she does not realize is that he is an undercover cop as well.

videos.title: Bait
videos.overview: A rapist whose latest victim was a college girl is sought by Pepper and Crowley.

videos.title: The Death of a Dream
videos.overview: Pepper Anderson, as well as a city councilman and his masseuse, is held hostage by terrorists.

videos.title: Father to the Man
videos.overview: A young girl who witnessed a murder becomes the target of two gangsters who meant to kill her father.

videos.title: Once a Snitch
videos.overview: Bernie Casey guest stars as P.J. Johnson. Pepper poses as a prostitute to learn why an attempt was made on the life of the new chief of police.

videos.title: Night of the Full Moon
videos.overview: Pepper is the decoy in a strategy to capture a schizophrenic young man who strangles middle-aged women.

videos.title: Banker's Hours
videos.overview: Pepper is on the trail of a gang of lady bank robbers.

videos.title: Disco Killer
videos.overview: Pepper assumes the identity of a woman who was shot during a record-company executive's murder.

videos.title: Shadow of a Doubt
videos.overview: Styles is suspected of complicity in the killing of his former girlfriend.

videos.title: The Killer Cowboys
videos.overview: Pepper renews her romance with a test pilot, and she and Crowley pursue homicidal thieves who dress as cowboys.

videos.title: Shark
videos.overview: A loan-shark operation terrorizes borrowers to collect bad debts.

videos.title: Solitaire
videos.overview: Pepper comes to the aid of an officer who is trying to recapture a cop killer that escaped while in his custody.

videos.title: Bondage
videos.overview: Pepper assumes the role of a porn queen after a hardcore porn film actress is murdered.

videos.title: Silky Chamberlain
videos.overview: Con men relieve Crowley's gullible uncle of his life's savings.

videos.title: Deadline: Death
videos.overview: After a reporter is killed by a car bomb, the man's son begins a search for his father's murderer.

videos.title: Do You Still Beat Your Wife?
videos.overview: Undercover cop Pepper Anderson and partner Bill Crowley aid a battered wife who refuses to press charges against her brutal husband.

videos.title: Guns
videos.overview: Pepper sets herself up as a target by offering Congressional testimony against an international gun-running operation.

videos.title: Means to an End
videos.overview: Pepper infiltrates a college drug ring to learn who is supplying cheap but lethal downers to students.

videos.title: The Inside Connection
videos.overview: Pepper poses as a prisoner to find the killer of a rookie policewoman who was investigation a drug operation in the women's county jail.

videos.title: Screams
videos.overview: A demented rapist-murderer is preying on hitchhikers.

videos.title: The Buttercup Killer
videos.overview: A killer attired in a nun's habit is slaying members of a Greek family, leaving only a dried buttercup as a clue.

videos.title: Merry Christmas, Waldo
videos.overview: An elderly Santa Claus robs banks using trickery, to assure his indigent friends a merry Christmas.

videos.title: Death Game
videos.overview: Pepper is driven to the brink of a nervous collapse by an unidentified assailant threatening her life.

videos.title: Ambition
videos.overview: An overzealous detective becomes implicated in an extortion scam.

videos.title: Blind Terror
videos.overview: It is a case of mistaken identity when criminals kidnap Pepper, thinking she is the wife of an accountant who uncovered payoffs from a criminal syndicate.

videos.title: Tigress
videos.overview: Pepper resents her assignment to protect an unscrupulous former classmate who is now a political candidate.

videos.title: Sunset
videos.overview: In the midst of the investigation into the death of a race car driver, Crowley and his dying ex-wife seek reconciliation.

videos.title: The Young and the Fair
videos.overview: A local professor may be involved with a white slavery racket, so Pepper goes undercover as a college student.

videos.title: The Human Rights of Tiki Kim
videos.overview: A young girl from Korea is abducted and held to prevent her from talking about the murder she witnessed.

videos.title: Sixth Sense
videos.overview: Crowley discovers a woman near death in a car trunk, but the driver — her assailant — is freed on a technicality.

videos.title: Sons
videos.overview: A rookie cop is beaten and a man tells the police what he knows about it, only to have his son murdered.

videos.title: Murder with Pretty People
videos.overview: A model agency owner, who was not a popular person to begin with, is murdered, sending Pepper undercover as a fashion model to find the killer.

videos.title: Battered Teachers
videos.overview: Teachers are being terrorized at a high school by local area hoods, so Pepper goes back to school to go after them.

videos.title: A Shadow on the Sea
videos.overview: Pepper, a waterfront cop and an old sea dog go after two boat hijackers who murdered a honeymooning couple and seem willing to steal and kill more to set up a smuggling operation.

videos.title: Sweet Kathleen
videos.overview: A woman tells Crowley a story of how she knew the details about a robbery but was forced to keep those facts to herself or face the consequences.

videos.title: Flip of a Coin
videos.overview: Styles's wife is facing surgery and he's having trouble concentrating on a kidnapping case.

videos.title: Good Old Uncle Ben
videos.overview: An old friend of Pepper's gets drawn into a cattle stealing scheme.

awards: Nominated for 7 Primetime Emmys. 2 wins & 15 nominations total
